title: First visit: register, seeded categories, first-run dashboard
expected: a brand-new account reaches a first-run dashboard with 8 categories and no ribbon

title: First expense: panel to server to refetched summary
expected: the entry appears only after the server confirms; the ribbon shows one band at 100%

title: Filtering from the ribbon, by pointer and by keyboard
expected: every number below the ribbon re-scopes; the ribbon itself does not; arrow keys reach every band

title: Locked out: failure, rate limit, admin reset, redemption
expected: the person regains access; all four redemption outcomes are distinguishable

title: Signed out mid-use: one redirect, draft preserved
expected: exactly ONE redirect despite concurrent 401s; the half-typed expense survives

title: Bootstrap: claim, and refuse-to-start when unset
expected: the nominated address becomes admin; an unset variable with zero admins aborts startup

title: A leaver: deactivation enforced at all three points
expected: login refused generically, sessions revoked, in-flight request refused explicitly

title: Second administrator: promote, demote, and both guards
expected: demote revokes; the last-admin guard refuses both demote and deactivate; peer reset 403s

title: After an incident: the record, including read-audits
expected: every mutation and every one of the three reads leaves exactly one row

title: What an administrator cannot do
expected: no amount, no description, no receipt, no IP, no delete, and 404 on another's id
